alt: An open, hand-painted ceramic book displays handwritten facts and a sketch of a Snowy Owl, resting on a sculpted snowy landscape with a feather and a painted winter background.
A close-up of a ceramic art piece featuring a hand-painted winter landscape with a blue stream and birch trees, framed by three-dimensional sculpted branches and accented with pink magnolia flowers.
An elaborate, multi-tiered cake decorated with a winter theme features two white owls perched on birch tree branches, surrounded by snowy landscapes, pink flowers, and a miniature open book.
A cluster of artificial pink and white speckled flowers with glossy green leaves is set against a light blue background, surrounded by dark, twisted branches.
A red book-shaped cake decorated with gold lettering and a bird illustration, resting on white fondant fabric with red ribbons and sugar feathers.
Two white owl figurines with yellow eyes and brown speckled feathers perch on grey branches adorned with red ribbons against a black background.

An intricately decorated cake features a sculpted birch tree trunk rising from a base adorned with pink flowers, green leaves, and a painted winter forest scene, accompanied by a fondant book and feather.
An intricately decorated cake features a hand-painted landscape of a river and birch trees, adorned with three-dimensional fondant branches, green leaves, and delicate pink blossoms.
Handcrafted pink dogwood blossoms with green leaves are arranged on brown stems against a backdrop of textured white birch bark.
Two sculpted snowy owls with yellow eyes perch on birch tree branches adorned with red ribbons, set against a black background above a painted winter landscape base.
A sculpted diorama of a snow-capped mountain with a forested green base, featuring white icing details that simulate snow on the peaks and trees.
